description: Every fill for one Hyperliquid wallet, optionally for one market, from indexed history: price, size, side, fee and realized PnL. Hyperliquid's own userFills endpoints stop at the 10,000 most recent fills.

market.description: Optional market filter: BTC-PERP or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

name: get_fills

outputSchema.description: Fills for one wallet, newest first

data.description: Fills for one wallet, newest first

base_market.description: Display symbol without the HIP-3 issuer prefix

issuer.description: HIP-3 builder code ("" for native markets)

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null on the last page

title: Wallet fills
